subject: [PATCH v4 2/3] mm: swap: refault on swap-in, not in the swap cache allocator

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch moves the evaluation of page refaults from the swap cache allocator to the two callers that perform swap-in operations. This change prevents inflated working set statistics when zswap writeback continuously writes back compressed data. The patch also ensures that the shadow is handed back correctly in the swap cache allocation function, and fixes a potential issue with stale snapshots being used for refault evaluation.
